description: LPA* (Lifelong Planning A*) finds a cheapest path from a fixed start to a fixed goal, and finds it again after edge costs change. It keeps two values per vertex: `g`, the cost it found, and `rhs`, a one-step lookahead from the predecessors' `g`. A vertex is *inconsistent* when the two differ, and only inconsistent vertices go on the queue. The first search costs about as much as A*; after a change, LPA* repairs only the part of the search tree that the change affects. With a *consistent* heuristic (one that never drops by more than the edge cost along an edge), every returned path is optimal.

papers.authors: Sven Koenig, Maxim Likhachev, David Furcy
papers.title: Lifelong Planning A*
